**Approach**: Use bash process substitution with `tee` to duplicate stderr to both the file and standard error stream.

command_parts.extend([

command_parts.extend([
    self.names.workflow_path,
    self.names.job_order_path,
    ">{}".format(self.names.run_workflow_stdout_path),                     # stdout -> file only (unchanged)
    "2> >(tee {} >&2)".format(self.names.run_workflow_stderr_path),        # stderr -> file AND stderr

- `2>` redirects stderr

- `>&2` redirects tee's stdout back to stderr (completing the loop)
